title: A service-named process reads the account file
threat_model: An attacker who controls a network service makes it read the account file, which is read by almost every program but not usually by a program started by a service.
notes: /etc/passwd alerts only when the reader runs below a service-named process. The nginx copy runs cat as a child, with the marker as a word of its command string, so the alert's ancestry carries the marker.
